root_cause: The focus trap listener (maintainFocus) remains active when restoring focus in hide(), causing focus to be returned to the dialog after attempting to restore focus to the opener.
repair_strategy: Move the removal of the focus and keydown listeners before the focus restoration call in the hide() method, ensuring the trap is disabled before attempting to focus the previously focused element.
expected_accessibility_effect: Focus will return to the element that opened the dialog after closing via Escape, satisfying keyboard focus order and preventing focus trapping.
functional_risks: Removing listeners early could theoretically affect any synchronous listeners that rely on them, but the dialog is already marked hidden and aria-hidden=true, so no further key events should be processed.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Escape on the dialog returns focus to the opener button.
Verify that focus trapping still functions correctly while the dialog is open (tabbing within dialog does not escape).
Verify that hiding via the close button also restores focus to the opener.
